text:
Maya Rivera: Kicking off NimbleRx onboarding — internal cadence + stakeholders. Customer kickoff with Caroline is Thurs 2pm ET. Need owners and success criteria. @Sam can you own integrations timeline?
Sam Cho: I can do integrations. Will pair with Li for infra. Can we confirm primary integration is real-time webhook + S3 batch?
Li Wei: Yes — webhook for real-time events, S3 for bulk backfills. ETA for integration work: 2 wks for webhook adapter + 1 wk for test harness. Blockers: customer needs a sandbox S3 bucket and API key.
Maya Rivera: Thanks. Olivia from CS ops — can you confirm enablement docs + training slot? Suggest 60-min enablement + 30-min dev office hours week after.
Olivia Patel: Confirmed — I can run the 60-min enablement on Mon 10am PT. I'll prepare a 15-slide deck + hands-on lab. Tom, can you prepare sample prompts and evals for the lab?
Tom Nguyen: On it. I'll drop a starter eval set in the repo and a short README. Suggest we include success metrics: latency <200ms p50, token cost target <$0.0005/token, and onboarding checklist completion by day 14.
Maya Rivera: Love that — finalizing success criteria: 1) Production calls to Redwood API w/in SLA, 2) Key integrations working (webhook + S3), 3) Team trained + run a sample scenario, 4) No critical regressions on quality evals. Any additions?
Sam Cho: Add: canary rollout plan — 10% traffic day 1, then 50% day 3 if stable. Also include rollback contact list in runbook.
Li Wei: I'll add runbook snippets. Example timeline (high level):
```
Week 0: Kickoff + access
Week 1: Webhook adapter dev + sandbox tests
Week 2: Backfill + integration hardening
Week 3: Enablement + canary
Week 4: Full rollout
```
Olivia Patel: :thumbsup: I'll send invite and agenda. Caroline (NimbleRx) asked about renewal touchpoints — suggest first QBR at 90 days and health check at 30 days.
Maya Rivera: Agree. Capture renewal risk flags: low usage (<10k tokens/week) at 30d, repeated latency spikes, and missed enablement session. We'll instrument usage alert in Console.
Tom Nguyen: Note: I'll add a small observability dashboard template and alert playbook in the repo.
Maya Rivera: Perfect. Owners recap:
- Maya (CS): overall success + stakeholder comms
- Sam (Solutions): integrations lead
- Li (Infra): runbook + infra
- Olivia (Enablement): training + docs
- Tom (QA): evals + observability
I'll DM Caroline copy. Anything else? If not, I'll post invites and set tasks.
Sam Cho: All good from me.
Li Wei: No blockers.
Olivia Patel: All good — sending invites now.
